import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000;
    static final int MAXNODE = 2 * 12 * 12 + 5;
    static final int MAXEDGE = 50000;

    static int N, T;
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][] good = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

    static int[] dirx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] diry = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static int[] head = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] nxt = new int[MAXEDGE];
    static int[] to = new int[MAXEDGE];
    static int[] cap = new int[MAXEDGE];
    static int[] flow = new int[MAXEDGE];
    static int ecnt;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        to[ecnt] = v; cap[ecnt] = c; flow[ecnt] = 0; nxt[ecnt] = head[u]; head[u] = ecnt++;
        to[ecnt] = u; cap[ecnt] = 0; flow[ecnt] = 0; nxt[ecnt] = head[v]; head[v] = ecnt++;
    }

    static int nNodes, src, snk;
    static int[] levelArr = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] curArr = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] qarr = new int[MAXNODE];

    static boolean bfs() {
        int h = 0, t = 0;
        qarr[t++] = src;
        Arrays.fill(levelArr, 0, nNodes, -1);
        levelArr[src] = 0;
        while (h < t && levelArr[snk] == -1) {
            int v = qarr[h++];
            for (int id = head[v]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
                int w = to[id];
                if (levelArr[w] == -1 && flow[id] < cap[id]) {
                    qarr[t++] = w;
                    levelArr[w] = levelArr[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return levelArr[snk] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int pushed) {
        if (pushed == 0) return 0;
        if (v == snk) return pushed;
        for (int id = curArr[v]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
            curArr[v] = id;
            int w = to[id];
            if (levelArr[w] != levelArr[v] + 1) continue;
            int got = dfs(w, Math.min(pushed, cap[id] - flow[id]));
            if (got > 0) {
                flow[id] += got;
                flow[id ^ 1] -= got;
                return got;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nNodes; i++) curArr[i] = head[i];
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(src, INF)) > 0) ans += pushed;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean pathExists(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty) {
        if (grid1[sx][sy] == 'Y' || grid1[sx][sy] == 'Z' || grid1[tx][ty] == 'Y' || grid1[tx][ty] == 'Z')
            return false;

        int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            if (x == tx && y == ty) return true;
            if (dist[x][y] >= T || dist[x][y] >= distZ[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dirx[d], ny = y + diry[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                    grid1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && grid1[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                    dist[nx][ny] == INF &&
                    dist[x][y] + 1 <= distZ[nx][ny]) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(distZ[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (grid1[x][y] == 'Z') {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dirx[d], ny = y + diry[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && grid1[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            distZ[nx][ny] = 1;
                            q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dirx[d], ny = y + diry[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                    grid1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && grid1[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                    distZ[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++)
                        good[x1][y1][x2][y2] = pathExists(x1, y1, x2, y2) ? 1 : 0;

        src = 0;
        snk = 2 * N * N + 1;
        nNodes = 2 * N * N + 2;

        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        ecnt = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] > '0' && grid1[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(src, 1 + i * N + j, grid1[i][j] - '0');
                if (grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(N * N + 1 + i * N + j, snk, grid2[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++)
                        if (good[x1][y1][x2][y2] == 1)
                            addEdge(1 + x1 * N + y1, N * N + 1 + x2 * N + y2, INF);

        System.out.println(dinic());
        sc.close();
    }
}
